summary: Defines the SIP P-Served-User private header for the 3GPP IP Multimedia Subsystem. It solves a problem between the S-CSCF and an application server on the ISC interface by identifying which user a request is being handled for.

eli5.summary: In a phone company's network, one server may ask another to do something for a specific customer. This note adds a label that says which customer the request is for.

questions: what is the sip p-served-user header
how does 3gpp ims identify the served user
